À Bout d’Aile Comme un Oiseau (ABACO), é: À Bout d’Aile Comme un Oiseau (ABACO), an FFVL school in the Lourdes and Pays de Bigorre area (65400), offers short, affordable tandem flights: the Découverte flight at €60 (7 to 9 minutes), the Bonheur flight at €70 (8 to 10 minutes), then the instructional tandem at €80 and the long flight at €80 (10 to 20 minutes). The take-off site is not specified on the listing: state your wishes in the free request, and the school will reply with a slot depending on the weather.
